scope_notes: 10 Jails dates explicitly shown on local January 2027 calendar (secondary publication); official Jails website confirms normally men-only outside specifically labelled mixed nights.

Eight Ted's Place dates and two Copper Club dates are extrapolated from published official weekly men-only themed schedules, not independently advertised January 2027 dates. Programme dates and holiday openings MUST be rechecked.
No mixed audience parties, no regular non-event opening hours, and no already listed January events imported.
The audit advances past entries without Website_URL but preserves those no_website_url_pending_other_sources entries for separate research.
